name: Demon Spore
storyline:
A cutting-edge genetic research lab. A population on the brink of collapse. Scientists pushed beyond every ethical limit in a desperate race to solve the world's food crisis. A routine experiment mysteriously triggers a catastrophic chain reaction, giving birth to a deadly viral organism — a rapidly evolving mass of flesh and tentacles with an insatiable hunger for organic matter.

Now trapped inside a facility on total lockdown, you must use your wits, your scientific know-how, and whatever you can find to fight your way out. Repurpose lab equipment, exploit the creature's weaknesses, and navigate an ever-changing environment as the horror evolves and spreads with every passing second. Demon Spore is an intense action rogue-lite inspired by classic 80s monster movies — brutal, atmospheric, and relentlessly unpredictable, with local and online co-op for up to four players.
summary: Blast your way out of tentacle hell as a failed lab experiment gives birth to a rapidly growing viral horror in this intense action rogue-lite inspired by 80s Monster movies. Use the lab to your advantage and improvise an escape plan before this constantly evolving life form spreads out of control.
